objective: Preallocate WAL segment discovery lists for the common base segment.

tasks.title: Preallocate WAL segment list
tasks.result: WAL segment discovery now creates its segment vector with capacity for the common base WAL segment.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid the recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The segment list capacity is 1 because the common existing WAL path pushes segment 0 before scanning rotated segment files.
The optimization only changes the initial Vec allocation for WAL segment discovery; file existence checks, rotated segment parsing, sorting, replay, and truncate semantics are unchanged.
